correctness.rationale: Every cycle uses complete terminal paths, so the exact cycle rank is max(R-1,0) for R completed paths. Factoring the independent Bernoulli normalizers leaves the stated multi-affine H_q. For distinct marks, the joint cumulant is the mixed log partition derivative with respect to log v at those edges; the independent factors have zero mixed derivative, so the chain rule multiplies the mixed log H_q derivative in (a_1,a_2,a_3) by e_3 times the product of (1-p_f). Independently expanding (H_123 H^2 - H sum H_ij H_k + 2 H_1 H_2 H_3) gives -(q-1)F_q; this symbolic identity and the illustrative threshold v=1.18042205579496... are replayable with `python /workspace/branches/audit_checks.py theta`. For an additional sign check put U=product(1+(q-1)a_i), V=product(1-a_i); exactly q H_q=U+(q-1)V and F_q=U-(q-1)V. Thus H_q>0 and U/V increases strictly from 1 to infinity under any prescribed common scaling, so F_q>0 for 1<q<=2 and has a unique negative-to-positive crossing for q>2. The cumulant has the opposite sign; at q=1 it is zero by independence. The crossing depends on path completion probabilities, not the particular mark choices. The packaged exact enumerator was inspected, not executed. These arguments do not address arbitrary activity trajectories, other mark placements, or thermodynamic transitions.
